correctness.rationale: Gamma-law for positive orthant monomial moments yields all displayed entries. Permutation decomposition has dimensions 3+3(d-1)+d(d-3)/2, exhaustive for degree<=2. Analytic polynomial uniqueness gives strict positivity. For asymptotics, the delta-method variance of the coordinate sum is 1-3/pi>0; conditional orthogonal quadratic residual and standard-block triangular change of basis prove top ~2d^2/pi^2 and bottom ~(pi-3)^2/(2d^2). Independent direct gamma-moment Gram computations verify full spectra in d=3..9 (224 supplemental checks), not used as all-d proof.

value.rationale: The positive orthant is a canonical incomplete-observation region, not a tuned slice. Full low-pass harmonic restriction is the natural inverse problem, and mixed-degree terms create a genuinely new high-dimensional instability: sharp restriction condition number asymptotic 2d^2/[pi(pi-3)], a full order worse than the linear restriction growth of the pure-degree-two problem. Two explicit order-three blocks determine every eigenvalue in arbitrary dimension, a useful exact spectral benchmark beyond a table or routine single instance.
